source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.

Walls modeled as representative midplanes: exterior 240mm at outer faces 0-15 x 0-8; corridor walls 120mm on both floors measured on the drawn double lines (1F midplanes y=5.009/2.990 per profile_003/claim_0001; 2F drawn midplanes 5.000/3.000, kept at 5.0054/3.0054 within ~1px), clear ~1.88m; interior partitions ~120-130mm at drawn midplanes x=5.0/10.0 (1F), x=7.5 (2F north), x=3.75/7.5/11.26 (2F south per profile_011/claim_0003)
Floors: F1 z0-3.0, F2 z3.0-6.6 per elevations (6600 total)

Window z per adopted elevation chains: F1 north W_N1-N3 (claim_0001) and wide south W_S2/W_S3 (claim_0002) sill 1.0 h1.6; small south W_S1 extent 1.5-2.1 (claim_0003, chain 900/600/1500); W_E1 sill 1.0 h1.8 (claim_0004, chain 200/1800/1000); all eight F2 windows sill 1.0 above F2 floor, abs 4.0-5.8 (claims_0005-0008, chains 800/1800/1000 read top-down: 800 is parapet-to-head, not the sill)
Exterior doors pixel-linked: D_SOUTHW 0-2.1 (claim_0009, head ~2.09 drawn); D_ENTRY_W 0-2.1 retained, drawn ~2.0-2.1 with no labeled chain (claim_0010); all interior doors remain assumed 2.1
Room uses: offices/meeting rooms per furniture; 7 physical spaces per floor match declaration thermal_zones=7 per floor (declaration field is simulation zoning, not authoritative room count)

2F corridor wall thickness verified by pixel profiles (profile_005/007/008): drawn faces rows 603/614 and 788/799 px give 120mm walls at midplanes y=5.000/3.000, clear 1.88m; the 2F dimension chains conflict and were not followed
1F top chain sums 14760 (not 15000); window W_N3 kept at drawn pixels

2F south partitions re-measured at drawn midplanes x=3.75/11.26 (profile_011, claim_0003) and applied; the earlier 3.804/11.315 were the east face lines
